n: Smart ENERGY STAR® Front Load Laundry Tower with UV Clean Technology & FreshFlowTM Vent System 4.5 cu. ft. Washer & 7.4 cu. ft. Electric Dryer
desc: This single-unit front load laundry tower features easy-to-reach controls and the FreshFlow™ Vent System with Industry-First UV Clean. Keep your clothes and washer fresh, now with the added benefit of UV light technology that reduces bacteria in the wash without requiring high temps or fading fabrics.
hl: Simplify your laundry routine with intelligent wash/dry technology.
The FreshFlow™ Vent System, now with UV Clean Technology, keeps your clothes and machine fresh and clean.
Customize your soak cycle options to your needs.
The single-unit front load laundry tower allows you to save space and effortlessly reach the centralized control panel
Industry-first UV Clean Technology reduces bacteria in the wash without requiring high temperatures or fading fabrics.
